description_en: Queries the list of gateway assets, ports, system components, or public IP addresses that are exposed on the Internet
description_zh: 查询暴露在互联网中的网关资产、端口、系统组件或公网IP列表
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-exposed-statistics-detail --page-size 20 --current-page 1 --statistics-type exposureType --statistics-type-instance-value lb-2ze4rso39h4nczcqs0000 --statistics-type-gateway-type SLB --resource-directory-account-id 12324284232340000 --uuid c9107c04-942f-40c1-981a-f1c1000 --criteria '{}' --instance-id s-bp1g6wxdwps7s9dz0000 --exposure-ip 116.12.XX.XX --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeExposedStatisticsDetail

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned per page.
Set PageSize to a non-empty value
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The type of statistics to query. Valid values:
exposureType: gateway assets exposed on the Internet.
exposurePort: ports exposed on the Internet.
exposureComponent: system components exposed on the Internet.
exposureIp: IP addresses exposed on the Internet
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查看的统计值类型。取值：
exposureType：暴露在互联网中的网关资产。
exposurePort：暴露在互联网中的端口。
exposureComponent：暴露在互联网中的系统组件。
exposureIp：暴露在互联网中的IP地址
parameters.name: statistics_type

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the gateway to query. This parameter takes effect only when StatisticsType is set to exposureType
parameters.help_zh: StatisticsType为exposureType时，指定要查询的网关实例ID
parameters.name: statistics_type_instance_value

parameters.help_en:
The Asset Type of the gateway to query. This parameter takes effect only when StatisticsType is set to exposureType. Valid values:
SLB: public IP address of a load balancing SLB instance.
DNAT: NAT gateway that uses the DNAT feature to connect to the Internet
parameters.help_zh:
StatisticsType为exposureType时，指定要查询的网关资产类型。取值：
SLB：负载均衡SLB公网IP。
DNAT：使用DNAT功能连接互联网的NAT网关
parameters.name: statistics_type_gateway_type

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member accounts in the resource folder.
Invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号主账号ID。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

parameters.help_en: The UUID of the server to query
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the asset to query
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的资产实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The public IP address that is exposed on the Internet for the asset to query
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的资产对外暴露的公网IP
parameters.name: exposure_ip
